sahneler.metin: A hurricane drove Lake Okeechobee over its dike.
Within hours, floodwater swept through farm towns, and thousands were killed.
The water didn't come from the ocean.
Hurricane winds piled the shallow lake against its southern shore.
The dike there was low and made of earth.
Most victims were migrant farm workers.
The massive Herbert Hoover Dike was built afterward.

aciklama:
Okeechobee hurricane overflowed and drowned farm towns. The cause: wind-driven surge on a shallow lake overtopping and breaching a small earthen dike.
